# G09a-resume-load-quiet: Fix resumes G04's session by session/load (loadSession advertised, session/resume not). Gemini streams the history after its answer (user, thought, the old tool calls completed, the old answer): the adapter drops every update until 400 ms of quiet, then re-sends set_mode and prompts. The pass's usage is its own prompt response as is (one prompt per process; pending live confirmation).
# --var sessionId=<G04's session id>, and --pass-file a scratch copy of pass.json whose resume.sessionId and resume.priorUsage are G04's live session id and done usage.
# <sandbox>: G04's sandbox again (Gemini sessions are project-scoped); never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G09a-resume-load-quiet --id G09a --slug resume-load-quiet --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09a-resume-load-quiet/stdin.jsonl --pass-file "<scratch pass.json>" --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09a-resume-load-quiet/responders.mjs --var sessionId=<the session id> --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
